'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Westergard DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
